title: Report choices
decision: A period is at most 366 Tashkent days ending no later than today; an entry and its reversal cancel out wherever each falls, so a past period's report can change when one of its sales is reversed later and a starting balance can be lower than it was on that day; opening balances are shown apart, so start plus credit plus opening minus payments equals end; debt promised for today has not fallen due; overdue debt is grouped as 1 to 7, 8 to 30, 31 to 90 and over 90 days; the ten largest debtors are listed; the count of disputes opened is included
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 37
rationale: REQ-046 names what the report covers but not how a reversal recorded after the period is treated; cancelling it everywhere keeps the totals equal to the ledger as it is known now
